scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.dev:api: set -a && (test -f env.local && . ./env.local; test -f .env.local && . ./.env.local; true) && set +a && PORT=8080 DATABASE_URL=memory:// SESSION_SECRET=dev-local-secret pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run dev
scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:api & pnpm run dev:web
scripts.db:push: set -a && (test -f env.local && . ./env.local; test -f .env.local && . ./.env.local; true) && set +a && pnpm --filter @workspace/db run push
scripts.deploy: pnpm run deploy:web && pnpm run deploy:api
